notes.title: Multiplayer Matchmaking Update!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=LZA21WmL9k4;full][/previewyoutube]

It's finally here! Our Multiplayer Matchmaking Beta has come to RiffTrax: The Game. Players can now host and join public games! No need to have friends in your house or share room codes with people on the internet. Of course, you can still play local and private games too.

In addition to the Multiplayer Beta update, we're also including an update to the Bad Word Filter. The new filter will have three options: none, some, and all. The "some" option will block slurs and hate speech while still allowing general profanity. All public matchmaking games will have the "some" filter enabled by default. Private and local games may adjust the filter to any setting. 

Looking ahead, we have our next content update which should launch in early August. Beyond that, we should have another 4 clip packs (maybe more) released by the end of this year.

Thanks again for continuing to support our game. We appreciate all your feedback, bug reports, custom clips, and community we've built so far. More to come!

notes.title: RiffTrax: The Game - 1.2 Streaming Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42114954/682542048095f4c86b1a5c4acd0256b116308b71.gif[/img]
[b]Version 1.2 of RiffTrax: The Game is now available! This update includes:[/b]

[u]Streaming[/u]
· Twitch Picks a Clip - While players are entering their riffs, Twitch chat can vote on the next clip to riff.

· Twitch Plays Pick a Riff - Chat can act as a player in PaR mode. Chat will automatically be dealt new Pick a Riffs each round. 

[u]Pick A Riff[/u]
· Riff Refresh Every Round - You can now enable auto-refresh riffs each round for all players. This option is found on the the game setup screen.

· Moderation - Moderation is now enabled in Pick a Riff mode.

[u]Riff Bot[/u]
· Options - Moved all Riff Bot options to it's own sub-menu.
· Riff Bot IQ - Player can now adjust Riff Bot's IQ for each game mode. Each setting (Hi, Med, Low) adjusts the frequency of random responses by Riff Bot. 

[u]Audio[/u]
· Disabled "Hurry up!" audio prompts in games where Twitch Chat voting is enabled. 

[u]Bugs[/u]
· TTS - Fixed a bug where non-English TTS would not play for remote players
· Winner Audio - "And the winner is..." audio is now synced across all remote players.

Run into a new bug? Submit a help ticket here:
[url=WRI Help Desk]https://widerightgames.freshdesk.com/support/solutions/articles/69000491525-create-a-support-ticket[/url]

Be sure to include your game logs, which are located here:
PC: [i]C:\Users\<username>\AppData\LocalLow\Wide Right Interactive\RiffTraxTheGame\Player.log [/i]
Mac: [i]~/Library/Logs/Wide Right Interactive/Rifftrax The Game/Player.log[/i]

notes.title: RiffTrax: The Game FAQ
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42114954/85136407b905f5c951bf97373c48b89bf8ac37f1.jpg[/img]

With RiffTrax: The Game launching in just over two weeks, we've been getting a lot of questions. So we put together a handy little guide to help. 

Did we miss anything? Got a burning question for the devs or RiffTrax team? Drop a comment below and we'll do our best to help.

[u]When is the game launching?[/u]
[b]May 5th! [/b]

[u]How much will it cost?[/u]
[b]RiffTrax: The Game will launch at $9.99 USD/€ 8.99 EUR. [/b]As is tradition, a 10% launch discount will be available for the first week.

[u]How is this any different from What The Dub?![/u]
For players familiar with WTD, these are the key improvements RiffTrax offers: 

[list]
[*] Overhauled multiplayer - Supports remote games, cross play, and in-app voice chat 
[*] Gameplay improvements like ranked voting and expanded/new SFX
[*] Expanded Twitch integration and new moderation options 
[*] Two gameplay modes (Write a Riff and Pick a Riff) 
[*] Includes [b]over 2,000 new riffs[/b] written and performed by the RiffTrax team.
[*] The addition of Riff Bot™ allows you to add a computer-controlled Riffer to your 3-5 player games
[*] Riff Bot™ enables voting in 2 player games (something that was highly requested)
[*] [b]250 new clips[/b] - including clips from licensed/non public domain sources (WTD clips were strictly public domain)
[*] The Steam version will also support custom clips ːsteamhappyː
[/list]
[u]How many people can play?[/u]
Up to six players can enter riffs and vote. An additional twelve audience members can vote. If you’re a streamer, you can enable [b]Twitch Chat Voting[/b] and allow your entire chat to vote!

[u]How do I play with friends?[/u]
In RiffTrax: The Game, players have a few options when it comes to multiplayer.
[list]
[*][b] Local Play[/b] - Simple! Get everyone in the same room and start a new game. Hope you have a huge couch because the game supports up to six players and twelve audience members.

[*] [b]Remote/Cross Play[/b] - Remote games allow owners of the game to host and join games from their platform of choice, no screen sharing, or streaming needed. You can even host local players from your remote setup too!

[*] Steaming - You stream the game. Simple. Oh, and if you plan on streaming, tag us on Twitter (@WideRightGames). We'd love to share it.
[/list]
[u]What films are included in the game?[/u]
The initial batch of over 250 clips were pulled from more than 60 feature and short films. We’ll have a full film list posted soon. We also included the film titles during clip playback, so you’ll always know what film you’re watching.

[u]Supported OS?[/u]
At launch we will be supporting Windows 10 and macOS 10.13 or higher. M1 Macs may use the Mac Intel build. A standalone Apple silicon version is coming later this year. 

[u]Install Size[/u]
Right now our launch version is weighing in at around 1.75 GB.

[u]Linux Support?[/u]
At this time we have no plans to officially support Linux. However, it may work with a version of Proton, but no native Linux support is planned at this time.

[u]Plans for new content?[/u]
I’m happy to announce that [b]we’ll be adding over 100 new clips[/b] to RiffTrax: The Game shortly after launch. This expansion will be a free update. You can expect more content updates later this summer.

[u]How can I support the game?[/u]
Right now, we'd appreciate if you wishlist the game. If you're on [url=https://twitter.com/widerightgames]Twitter[/url], give us a follow. Thanks!

notes.title: RiffTrax: The Game has you and your pals crack jokes over bad movies
notes.notes:
After making What The Dub?!, a game which is basically about cracking jokes over bad movies like you're on Mystery Science Theater 3000, Wide Right Interactive are now getting even Mistier. Today they announced RiffTrax: The Game, teaming up with the post-MST3K jokefest for an official new party game about making your pals laugh by cracking jokes over bad movies.
